name: The Beatles

whyMatters.en: Liverpool band, 1960–1970. From Hamburg and Cavern live shows through Parlophone singles and the US breakthrough, then toward the Abbey Road studio.
whyMatters.zh: 利物浦乐队，1960–1970。从汉堡和 Cavern 的现场演出开始，经过 Parlophone 单曲和美国市场突破，最终把创作重心转向 Abbey Road 的录音室。

note.en: Debut Parlophone single; UK chart peak #17.
note.zh: Parlophone 处女单曲；英国榜最高第 17 名。

essentialTracks.title: I Want to Hold Your Hand

note.zh: 首支美国 Billboard Hot 100 冠军（1964 年 2 月 1 日）。

note.en: McCartney song from Help!; string arrangement.
note.zh: 出自《Help!》的 McCartney 作品；含弦乐编曲。

note.en: Revolver track; tape loops and studio processing.
note.zh: 出自《Revolver》；磁带循环与录音室处理。

note.en: Sgt. Pepper; orchestral rise and final piano chord.
note.zh: 出自《Sgt. Pepper》；管弦爬升与末尾钢琴和弦。

note.en: White Album; Eric Clapton on lead guitar.
note.zh: 白专；主音吉他为 Eric Clapton。

note.en: Seven-minute single; Revolution on the B-side.
note.zh: 约七分钟单曲；B 面为 Revolution。

scenes.track: I Want to Hold Your Hand

note.en: Capitol US single; Billboard Hot 100 #1 on 1 February 1964. Eight days later, first Ed Sullivan Show appearance reached about 73 million viewers. By 4 April 1964, four of the Hot 100 top five were Beatles songs.
note.zh: Capitol 美国单曲；1964 年 2 月 1 日 Billboard Hot 100 冠军。八天后首次登上 Ed Sullivan Show，约 7300 万人收看。至 1964 年 4 月 4 日，Hot 100 前五中有四首是 Beatles。

note.en: From Sgt. Pepper. Lennon and McCartney sections join via orchestral build and a sustained final piano chord. George Martin later linked Beach Boys studio work to this period; Pet Sounds had already followed Rubber Soul.
note.zh: 出自《Sgt. Pepper》。Lennon 与 McCartney 段落由管弦爬升和末尾延音钢琴和弦衔接。George Martin 后来谈到 Beach Boys 与这一时期的关联；Pet Sounds 已出现在《Rubber Soul》之后。

note.en: Harrison song on the White Album; Eric Clapton on lead guitar. Around the 1968 Rishikesh period, Lennon was photographed with Beach Boys’ Mike Love.
note.zh: 白专上的 Harrison 作品；主音吉他为 Eric Clapton。约 1968 年瑞诗凯诗前后，Lennon 与 Beach Boys 的 Mike Love 有过会面记录。

note.en: Abbey Road opener. Abbey Road (1969) was recorded after Let It Be sessions but released first; includes Harrison’s Something and Here Comes the Sun.
note.zh: 《Abbey Road》开场曲。《Abbey Road》（1969）录于《Let It Be》之后却先发行；含 Harrison 的 Something 与 Here Comes the Sun。

shortBio.en: Liverpool band, 1960–1970. Early live experience in Hamburg and at the Cavern Club, then a Parlophone deal. After entering the US market in 1964, the focus moved from live shows toward the studio until the 1970 split.
shortBio.zh: 利物浦乐队，1960–1970。最初在汉堡和 Cavern 俱乐部积累现场经验，随后签约 Parlophone。1964 年进入美国市场后，乐队的重心逐渐从现场演出转向录音室，直到 1970 年解散。

body.en: Liverpool band, 1960–1970. Early live experience in Hamburg and at the Cavern Club, then a Parlophone deal. After entering the US market in 1964, the focus moved from live shows toward the studio until the 1970 split.
body.zh: 利物浦乐队，1960–1970。最初在汉堡和 Cavern 俱乐部积累现场经验，随后签约 Parlophone。1964 年进入美国市场后，乐队的重心逐渐从现场演出转向录音室，直到 1970 年解散。

body.en:
Early Beatles sound rested on two guitars, bass, drums, and vocal harmony. Songs were usually short and direct, with clear verses and choruses.

Later the same four-piece remained the core, but recording methods changed. Tape edits, varispeed, sitar, orchestra, and longer song forms entered the work. The shift was mainly in writing, arranging, and recording—not in who was in the band.
body.zh:
早期 Beatles 以双吉他、贝斯、鼓和人声和声为基础，歌曲通常短小直接，主歌和副歌清楚。

到了后期，四人仍是核心阵容，但录音方式明显改变。磁带剪辑、变速、西塔琴、管弦乐和更长的歌曲结构陆续进入作品。变化主要发生在写作、编曲和录音，而不是乐队成员本身。

body.en:
Long Hamburg residencies gave the early Beatles heavy live experience and a more stable stage lineup.

After Stuart Sutcliffe stayed in Hamburg, the others returned to Liverpool and kept playing the Cavern Club. Record-shop owner Brian Epstein then became their manager and pushed a Parlophone deal in 1962. That year Pete Best left; Ringo Starr took over on drums.
body.zh:
汉堡的长期驻唱让早期 Beatles 获得了大量现场经验，也逐渐形成稳定的演出阵容。

Stuart Sutcliffe 留在汉堡后，其余成员返回利物浦，并在 Cavern 俱乐部持续演出。唱片行老板 Brian Epstein 随后成为经纪人，推动乐队在 1962 年签约 Parlophone。同年，Pete Best 离队，Ringo Starr 接替鼓手位置。

alt.en: The Beatles 1963 Capitol publicity photo (Dezo Hoffmann)
alt.zh: The Beatles 1963 年 Capitol 宣传照（Dezo Hoffmann）

body.en:
In 1960–62, besides Lennon, McCartney, and Harrison, the band also included bassist Stuart Sutcliffe and drummer Pete Best.

From August 1962 the recording lineup stayed John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, and Ringo Starr through the band’s final phase. Early hits were written mainly by Lennon and McCartney; later, Harrison’s share of album tracks grew.
body.zh:
1960–62 年，Lennon、McCartney、Harrison 之外，乐队还有贝斯手 Stuart Sutcliffe 和鼓手 Pete Best。

1962 年 8 月起，录音阵容固定为 John Lennon、Paul McCartney、George Harrison 和 Ringo Starr，并延续到乐队最后阶段。早期热门歌曲主要由 Lennon 与 McCartney 创作，后期 Harrison 的作品在专辑中的比重逐渐增加。

title.en: I Want to Hold Your Hand and Ed Sullivan
title.zh: 《I Want to Hold Your Hand》与 Ed Sullivan

body.en:
I Want to Hold Your Hand was released in Britain in late 1963 and became a Capitol US single that December.

On 1 February 1964 it reached Billboard Hot 100 #1. Eight days later The Beatles first appeared on the Ed Sullivan Show, to an audience of about 73 million. By 4 April 1964, four of the Hot 100 top five were Beatles songs.

Twin lead vocals, clear choruses, and sharp rhythm made these songs well suited to singles and radio.
body.zh:
《I Want to Hold Your Hand》于 1963 年末在英国发行，同年 12 月成为 Capitol 的美国单曲。

1964 年 2 月 1 日，它登上 Billboard Hot 100 冠军。八天后，The Beatles 首次登上 Ed Sullivan Show，约 7300 万人收看。到 1964 年 4 月 4 日，Billboard Hot 100 前五名中有四首来自 Beatles。

双主唱、清楚的副歌和鲜明的节奏，让这一时期的歌曲非常适合单曲和广播播放。

alt.en: The Beatles arrive at JFK Airport, 7 February 1964
alt.zh: The Beatles 抵达肯尼迪机场，1964 年 2 月 7 日

title.en: Shared facts with Beach Boys and Stones
title.zh: 与 Beach Boys、Stones 的交叉事实

body.en:
The Beach Boys’ Pet Sounds (1966) is another major studio album finished after Rubber Soul. George Martin later linked Beach Boys recording methods with the making of Sgt. Pepper.

In 1968 in Rishikesh, a photo of John Lennon with Beach Boys’ Mike Love survives from the period when the Beatles were working on White Album material.

Lennon–McCartney also wrote I Wanna Be Your Man for the Rolling Stones. Both bands covered Chuck Berry early on.
body.zh:
The Beach Boys 的《Pet Sounds》（1966）是在《Rubber Soul》之后完成的另一张重要录音室专辑。George Martin 后来谈到 Beach Boys 的录音方法时，也将它与《Sgt. Pepper》的制作联系起来。

1968 年在瑞诗凯诗，John Lennon 与 Beach Boys 的 Mike Love 同框的照片被保存下来，当时 Beatles 正在进行白专辑相关创作。

Beatles 的 Lennon–McCartney 还为 Rolling Stones 写过《I Wanna Be Your Man》。两支乐队早期都录过 Chuck Berry 的作品。

body.en:
From Revolver (1966) on, Abbey Road’s recording conditions and methods became a large part of how Beatles sound changed. Four-track, eight-track, multitrack overdubs, tape loops, and varispeed were used more and more often.

Tomorrow Never Knows is a clear studio piece from this period. Sgt. Pepper (1967) went further in joining recording, arrangement, and album structure—including Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds and A Day in the Life.

After touring stopped in 1966, more time went into the studio. Strawberry Fields Forever / Penny Lane and Magical Mystery Tour continued that direction.
body.zh:
从《Revolver》（1966）开始，Abbey Road 的录音条件和制作方法成为 Beatles 声音变化的重要部分。四轨、八轨、多轨叠录、磁带循环和变速等技术被越来越频繁地使用。

《Tomorrow Never Knows》是这一时期较典型的录音室作品。《Sgt. Pepper》（1967）则进一步把录音、编曲和专辑整体结构结合起来，其中包括《Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds》和《A Day in the Life》。

1966 年停止巡演后，乐队可以把更多时间投入录音室。随后发行的《Strawberry Fields Forever / Penny Lane》以及《Magical Mystery Tour》，都延续了这一方向。

alt.en: The Beatles 1967 promo photo for All You Need Is Love
alt.zh: The Beatles 1967 年 All You Need Is Love 宣传照

body.en:
The Beatles (1968), usually called the White Album, includes Back in the U.S.S.R., Dear Prudence, Blackbird, and While My Guitar Gently Weeps, and further raised each member’s share of independent writing.

The same year’s Hey Jude runs near seven minutes, with Revolution on the B-side.

Let It Be sessions were difficult; Starr briefly left during the White Album period, and Harrison also left during Let It Be production.

Abbey Road was recorded after Let It Be but released before it. It includes Come Together, Something, Here Comes the Sun, and McCartney’s medley. The 1969 Apple rooftop show was the Beatles’ last public concert.
body.zh:
1968 年的《The Beatles》（通常称为“白专”）包含《Back in the U.S.S.R.》《Dear Prudence》《Blackbird》和《While My Guitar Gently Weeps》等作品，也进一步增加了四位成员各自独立创作的比例。

同年发行的《Hey Jude》接近七分钟，B 面为《Revolution》。

《Let It Be》的录音过程并不顺利，Starr 曾在白专期间短暂离队，Harrison 也曾在《Let It Be》制作期间离开。

《Abbey Road》实际录制在《Let It Be》之后，却先于它发行。专辑包括《Come Together》《Something》《Here Comes the Sun》以及 McCartney 的组曲。1969 年 Apple 屋顶演出成为 Beatles 最后一次公开音乐会。

body.en:
Lennon–McCartney harmony, middle-eight bridges, and album sequencing became material later rock writers studied and reused.

EMI-era overdubs, tape edits, and non-standard instrument colors also entered later psychedelic rock, progressive rock, and indie production.
body.zh:
Lennon–McCartney 的和声、歌曲中的中八桥段，以及专辑曲目之间的编排方式，都成为后来摇滚写作者反复研究和引用的对象。

与此同时，EMI 年代形成的叠录、磁带剪辑和非传统乐器音色，也进入了后来的迷幻摇滚、progressive rock 和 indie 制作。

body.en:
There are many Beatles interviews, documentaries, and tape archives. What usually matters more than a summary judgment is the concrete process: who wrote which section, who played what, and how a song moved from demo to final take.

That is also why the later records repay close listening: changes in the same song often happen in the studio.
body.zh:
关于 Beatles 的采访、纪录片和录音档案很多。真正值得关注的，往往不是一句概括性的评价，而是具体的创作过程：谁写了哪一段，谁负责演奏，一首歌怎样从 demo 变成最终录音。

这也是 Beatles 后期作品最值得反复听的地方：同一首歌的变化，往往发生在录音室里。

note.en: Hamburg residencies. Sutcliffe stayed in Hamburg; Best left in 1962 when Ringo Starr joined.
note.zh: 汉堡驻唱时期。Sutcliffe 留在汉堡；Best 于 1962 年离队，由 Ringo Starr 接替。

note.en: Four-piece from August 1962 through the 1970 split; recording lineup from Please Please Me to Let It Be / Abbey Road.
note.zh: 自 1962 年 8 月起四人固定，直至 1970 年解散；录音阵容从《Please Please Me》到《Let It Be》/《Abbey Road》。

debutTrack.title: I Want to Hold Your Hand

note.en: Capitol US single; Billboard Hot 100 #1 in February 1964. The same month, The Beatles first appeared on the Ed Sullivan Show.
note.zh: Capitol 美国单曲；1964 年 2 月登上 Billboard Hot 100 冠军。同月，The Beatles 首次登上 Ed Sullivan Show。

note.en: In the mid-to-late 1960s, The Beatles put songwriting, arrangement, and multitrack recording into one creative process; the studio became part of the finished work.
note.zh: 1960 年代中后期，The Beatles 把歌曲写作、编曲和多轨录音放在同一个创作流程里，录音室本身也成为作品的一部分。
